input.reply:
Thanks for the detailed report and reproduction case.

This is a legitimate issue: `toMatchScreenshot` with `--update` should only regenerate screenshots when the comparator **fails** (i.e., actual != expected), not unconditionally on every run. The current behavior makes it impossible to use `--update` in CI when your UI has non-deterministic elements, as screenshots change even when tests pass.

The expected behavior (consistent with snapshot testing in most frameworks) is:
- `--update` flag: regenerate only if comparison fails
- To force regeneration: delete `__screenshots__/` directory

This requires a fix in the screenshot comparison logic to only write the file when the comparator returns false/fails. The reproduction repo you linked will help verify the fix.
